The soup tastes good
Nov 2023 • Solo
If you want to eat pho in Nha Trang, this is the place to go.
It seemed like there were a constant stream of customers.
When you enter the restaurant and sit down somewhere, they come to take your order. There was no menu on the seat, so they brought one to you.
The menu has pictures and English, so it's easy to understand. I ordered the second beef pho.
The soup tastes good. You can mix it with seasonings, but it was delicious just as is.
The noodles are average. Overall, I thought it was delicious for Nha Trang. You can choose between a small and large size, but the small was enough. They also brought lots of vegetables.
When I made eye contact with a young lady sitting nearby to pay the bill, she paid me.

Lost its taste
Sep 2019 • Solo
It’s my 3rd visit to Nha Trang over the past 2 years and I come here everytime.
Obviously it was becoz I really love their pho therefore I kept eating here.
I’m not sure if they changed their target, trying to attract more tourists rather than serving locals. The restaurant was packed with Koreans/mainland Chinese which I’ve never encountered. And the taste and quality was definitely different from my first try. It wasn’t delicious anymore, it was average. I mean, it didn’t make me “Mmmm.....😋” (like the first 2 times)
So this visit was a disappointment and I would say I might never come back.
